workItem: Replace post-create runner-backed PR label classification with fail-closed pre-create project classification and attach the canonical colored project label during PR creation.
workItemDE: Die runner-basierte PR-Label-Klassifizierung nach PR-Erstellung durch fail-closed Pre-Create-Projektklassifizierung ersetzen und das kanonische farbige Projektlabel bereits bei der PR-Erstellung anhängen.

correlation.semanticOverlap: PR #1199 modifies separate existing PR autofix/sync workflows and does not write the PR-create or label-classification files. Other open PRs are project/domain slices with no claimed-path overlap. This work remains Governance-owned and preserves existing merge/security controls.

releaseCondition: Release on Human Owner merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
